topic: Dashboard map and real-time data issues
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on missing Map & Live stats for a location (Lithuania). It was determined that the map should appear automatically once data is available. Multiple participants confirmed issues with real-time session data; initially, only 'F' data was flowing, not current sessions.

Later, it was identified that there were factor issues with new tenants. The system failed to use a general default when factors were missing for companies, which needs fixing for the future.
decisions: The map display is dependent on the availability of data.
action_items: Fix the process so that the system automatically uses a general default when tenant-specific factors are missing.
